 Business Description
Price reduction! Attention all plumbers. Financing pre-approved.
**0.60 acres** with **158 feet of frontage on US 1** and a **1,400-square-foot building** located at the rear of the property, allowing for further development along US 1. Very well-established septic and commercial grease trap clean-out company with **over 400 mandated aerobic septic system maintenance contracts** and numerous commercial grease trap clean-out contracts.
The business includes extensive, well-maintained equipment, an office building, and trained, professional staff with strong operational employees. Manager will qualify a buyer if needed.
